title: Unbalanced signed bipartite graphs containing no negative $C_4$ with maximum spectral radius
summary: A signed graph $(G,σ)$ is a graph $G$ together with an assignment $σ$ of either a positive sign or a negative sign to each edge. A signed graph is unbalanced if it contains a cycle with odd number of negative edges. The spectral radius of a signed graph is the spectral radius of its adjacency matrix, in which for vertices $u,v$, the $(u,v)$-entry is $0$, $-1$, or $1$ depending on whether $uv$ represents no edge, a negative edge, or a positive edge, respectively.
